title: Former Yan
capsule: The Former Yan was a Xianbei state founded by the Murong clan during the Sixteen Kingdoms period of 4th-century northern China. It expanded across northeastern China and the North China Plain before being conquered by the Former Qin in 370. It shared the ancient regional name Yan but had no political continuity with the Zhou-era state.
